name: drum_fall_a
prompt: A wooden marching drum is thrown off a high cliff: a quick whoosh, then the hollow drum tumbles and rattles down the rocks getting quieter and farther away, a short pause of air, then a big heavy splash into a river far below with spray and a watery tail. No music.

name: drum_fall_b
prompt: Hollow wooden drum falling into a canyon, bouncing and clattering off rock, fading with distance, silence for a moment, then one large deep water splash with echo. Foley, close perspective, no music.

name: splash_big_a
prompt: One big heavy object plunging into deep river water: a loud clear splash, spray falling back, bubbling watery tail. Single event, no music, no voices.

name: splash_big_b
prompt: Large rock dropped into a lake from height, huge deep splash with water spray and ripples settling. Single clean sound effect.

name: drum_tumble_only
prompt: A hollow wooden drum tumbling and bouncing down a rocky slope, wooden knocks and rattling drumsticks, getting quieter as it falls away. No splash, no music.

name: swing_rope
prompt: A child's rope swing hanging from a tree branch creaking slowly back and forth, rope and wood creak, outdoors, rhythmic, no voices.

name: chuckles
prompt: Three or four young men chuckling and snickering together, amused, short, close, no words.

name: general_laugh
prompt: An old pompous man laughing out loud heartily, belly laugh, wheezing with tears, comic, no words.

name: fife_march
prompt: Solo military fife playing a cheerful simple 18th century marching tune in D major at 88 beats per minute, dry recording, no drums, no other instruments.

name: bridge_groan
prompt: An old wooden suspension bridge groaning and creaking under heavy rhythmic load, timber stress, iron chains straining, slow pulses, no footsteps, no voices.

name: bridge_snap_a
prompt: A huge wooden bridge suddenly snapping and bucking: one massive timber crack, chains breaking with a metallic clang, deep boom, planks and debris flying. Cinematic impact, single event.

name: bridge_snap_b
prompt: Massive wooden structure collapse: loud splintering wood crack, heavy low impact, breaking chain, debris. Powerful, punchy, no music.

name: bodies_splashes
prompt: Dozens of people falling from the sky into a river: comic falling yells and wind rush, then many splashes one after another, big and small, ending with one large splash.

name: whoosh_tight_a
prompt: Short tight airy whoosh, fast camera whip pan transition, soft high air, no low rumble, very brief.

name: whoosh_tight_b
prompt: Quick light swish of air passing left to right, thin and clean, cinematic transition, under half a second.

name: whoosh_tight_c
prompt: Fast soft swoosh, cloth-like air movement, short, dry, no impact, no tail.
